title: cerasus occidentalis
intro: Cerasus occidentalis, commonly known as Western plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the western United States. It is valued for its edible fruit and medicinal properties, offering a range of health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which may help to protect against chronic diseases and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Western plum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and cardiovascular-protective properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as amygdalin, epicatechin, and ferulic acid, contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for traditional and modern medicine.
